messages.subject: [Genabel-announce] ProbABEL v0.4.5 released
messages.body_plain:
Dear user of the GenABEL suite,

On behalf of those who contributed I am happy to announce the release of
ProbABEL v0.4.5.
This is a bugfix release fixing one serious bug in the Cox regression
module, as well as several other bugs of lesser importance (also in the
Cox module). Users of pacoxph are strongly advised to upgrade. For users
of the linear and logistic modules nothing has changed.

Please read the full announcement on the GenABEL website at
http://www.genabel.org/node/299. The tar-ball with the source code can
be found at http://genabel.org/packages/ProbABEL
Updated Debian and Ubuntu packages will be released shortly.

Special thanks go to the people who have contributed to this release by
sending extensive bug reports via e-mail and the forum, as well as
testing the fixes: forum user 'quentin300' and Anne Grotenhuis, thank
you for your efforts!

Questions regarding this release are welcome on our forum:
http://forum.genabel.org. Bugs and feature requests can be reported via
our trackers on R-forge: https://r-forge.r-project.org/tracker/?group_id=505


Best regards,

Lennart.
--
